Poelaert's drawings of the Brussels Palace of Justice, from the Commons category of its architectural drawings: two elevations with the tall dome and a section; the 1862 elevation and section (earlier lower-dome scheme) and the city development plan left out.
Van Gendt's sheet for the Amsterdam Concertgebouw: plans, elevations and hall interior (De Opmerker). The 'Den Haag plan' is a different building and is left out.
Plan and section drawing of the Breuer Building (Whitney, Madison Ave).

why: First-floor plan (clearest of three near-identical versions), Östberg's 1909 facade drawing and his 1918-19 tower sketches. The unbuilt 'Mälardrott' competition entry left out.
Floor plan of the Detroit Fisher Building (Albert Kahn). The Chicago HABS Fisher Building photo is a different building.

Gerd Hänska's own drawings of the Zentrale Tierlaboratorien (Mäusebunker): second-floor plan, long elevations, cross-sections and the sheet titled Perspektive (shows views of the building as line drawings).
